meta.source: TYRŠ web canvas (Claude Design), Oct 2026 — supersedes the designer's Sept draft

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The page ground on every screen: warm paper, never pure white or grey. Raised white cards read as objects placed on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: White cards that group related content: the event mosaic, the month list, the calendar, side info cards, the timetable. Radius only, no shadow, no border.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Image wells while photos load, empty calendar days, neutral chips.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Black info bands on event and course detail, primary buttons, the now-playing capsule, the mobile sticky bar.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text, rules and icons. Pure black; the brand is high-contrast.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary labels and metadata: day markers, small captions, footer column heads. 6.2:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative or large text only (3.1:1). Never for navigation or anything a visitor must read.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The 2px rules between programme rows, under section heads and at the footer top. Rules are black and confident, never pale hairlines.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet dividers inside white cards (timetable grid, dividers between card sections).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px with 2px offset.

tokens.name: green-deep
tokens.usage: TYRŠ dark green: the Spotify playlist card, the listen button, focus rings. Text on it is constant-white (9.5:1).

tokens.name: green-live
tokens.usage: The play disc, live dots, and the action buttons that commit a visitor: Vstupenky, Přihlásit se. Text on it is constant-black.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: The accent band colour: the Pronájem band, quote bands, the Kontakt tile, 'Nehodí se ti…' cards and the Pohyb tag. Black text only. One butter element per screen region.

tokens.name: cat-hudba
tokens.usage: Hudba (music) chip and pill ground. Black text, 8.9:1.

tokens.name: cat-hudba-tint
tokens.usage: Light stop of the Hudba drift gradient.

tokens.name: cat-hudba-shade
tokens.usage: Dark stop of the Hudba drift gradient.

tokens.name: cat-hudba-edge
tokens.usage: Hover / selected border of a Hudba chip or pill (3px).

tokens.name: cat-divadlo
tokens.usage: Divadlo (theatre) chip and pill ground. Black text.

tokens.name: cat-divadlo-tint
tokens.usage: Light stop of the Divadlo drift gradient.

tokens.name: cat-divadlo-shade
tokens.usage: Dark stop of the Divadlo drift gradient.

tokens.name: cat-divadlo-edge
tokens.usage: Hover / selected border of a Divadlo chip or pill.

tokens.name: cat-tanec
tokens.usage: Tanec (dance) chip and pill ground. Black text.

tokens.name: cat-tanec-tint
tokens.usage: Light stop of the Tanec drift gradient.

tokens.name: cat-tanec-shade
tokens.usage: Dark stop of the Tanec drift gradient.

tokens.name: cat-tanec-edge
tokens.usage: Hover / selected border of a Tanec chip or pill.

tokens.name: cat-lekce
tokens.usage: Lekce (all classes and courses) chip ground, and the fill of course slots in the weekly timetable. Black text.

tokens.name: cat-lekce-tint
tokens.usage: Light stop of the Lekce drift gradient.

tokens.name: cat-lekce-shade
tokens.usage: Dark stop of the Lekce drift gradient.

tokens.name: cat-lekce-edge
tokens.usage: Hover / selected border of a Lekce chip or pill.

tokens.name: duotone-shadow
tokens.usage: Shadow colour of the photo duotone (warm espresso). Applied with mix-blend-mode: lighten over a grayscale photo.

tokens.name: duotone-light
tokens.usage: Highlight colour of the photo duotone (warm paper). Applied with mix-blend-mode: multiply.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Social formats and internal notices only; not used on the website. Text on it is constant-black.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Prohibitions and frames in social formats only. A mark, never a text ground.

tokens.name: constant-white
tokens.usage: White that never flips: titles over photography, badge grounds on photos, text on green-deep.

tokens.name: constant-black
tokens.usage: Black that never flips: text on butter, green-live and every category colour.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Bottom-up wash on photo tiles (to transparent at 55%) so white titles stay legible.

styles.name: display-month
styles.usage: The month headline on Program and the homepage list (Říjen). Mobile 88–104px.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The homepage hero sentence with category pills; big event and course titles over photos. Mobile 52/50.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section heads (Tenhle týden v kurzech, Další akce) and mosaic tile titles. Mobile 36–56px.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Event titles in programme rows; space names on Pronájem. Mobile 36px.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Card headings and values in the black info band (Kdy, Cena).

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Desktop main navigation. Always black; hover rolls the word, active gets a 4px underline.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs on Venue, Pronájem and detail pages.
styles.sample: Dům na Malé Straně, kde se během jednoho dne vystřídá jóga, zkouška kapely a večerní představení.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Kapela vznikla ve zkušebně na Žižkově.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body inside cards, footer links on desktop (22px there).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, badges, buttons on mobile, times.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footer column heads (uppercase, 0.06em tracking), micro labels.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Quotes on butter bands (motto, rental reference). Mobile 28/36. One per page at most.

styles.name: editorial
styles.usage: Longer editorial passages where the sans would feel like an interface.

spacing.note: A 4px base. The draft's layouts land on multiples of 8 for structure and 4 for anything inside a control.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a chip's icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, gap between adjacent chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding inside buttons and rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between footer link lines.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Inset of white cards from the page edge on desktop; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a section header and its content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space between stacked sections on a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter for text; space above the footer on mobile is space-7.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Separation between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top of page to hero, and the breathing room the draft leaves around the map.

radius.note: Rounded, never soft. Big white cards, medium tiles, pill controls.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: White date badges on photos.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Row thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Timetable slots, small cards on mobile.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Photo tiles, event cards, mobile white cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Desktop white cards and black info bands (20px).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, chip, pill, capsule and the play disc.
